axes.name: Hook & retention
axes.rationale: The opening hand catches an oversized control under a readable question; the repeated control pays off at TEST AGAIN. The extended source/setup stretch before the first result is more explanatory than surprising.

axes.name: Illustration craft & detail
axes.rationale: The control has metal shading, outlined detents and cable detail; the researcher has face planes, coat quilting, reflective trim and trouser folds at similar finish. Concrete unevenness remains: harbor houses use largely unshaded flat walls and roofs, and the disembodied blue sleeve ends visibly within the harbor frame around 101-110s, weakening physical continuity.

axes.name: Motion & animation craft
axes.rationale: Actually inspected all eight consecutive-frame strips. The caught grip rotates with its hand, initiating fingers release and withdraw, feedback token advances independently, the result flap changes perspective, the gate retracts, collar halves separate, and ending grip settles. Held harbor researcher has only restrained pose variation; the performance is less expressive than the moving apparatus. The ending sleeve remains a rigid wedge while its hand/control move.

axes.name: Composition & staging
axes.rationale: The two cases occupy distinct architectures; the common test gives learned and predefined lanes equal scale. Captions have a stable separate dark band. At 70.5s STOCK-LINKED RECRUITMENT is duplicated on two stacked plates, and at 110s the closing question crowds the gripping hand and hides much of the rear test apparatus. These are minor hierarchy costs, not clipped claims.

axes.name: Color & grade
axes.rationale: Ultramarine and sea-glass fit the marine research setting, with mango directing attention to the control, coat and quay. The warm harbor shift is cohesive and visibly distinct from the cream/plum historical anchor. Broad pale laboratory walls remain somewhat uniform; the blue is motivated by this story rather than an unexplained default.

axes.name: Typography & captions
axes.rationale: Bold serif plaques and monospaced captions remain readable in the contact sheets and native frames; supplied gates confirm alignment/render presence. Long explanations require three caption lines, and plate hierarchy is repetitive. The dedicated end card is present for ten seconds and readable at native size; its single-line music attribution is distinctly smaller and less comfortable than the source rows.

axes.name: Sound design & mix
axes.rationale: Assessment is based on current measurements, event map, music status and voice report, not human listening. Master measures -14.36 LUFS, -3.26 dBTP and 6.9 LU LRA; 38 motivated events span contact, metal, paper, water and latch actions, with 21 measured audible lifts and a 98.3s music dip. This supports a shaped mix, while timbral taste and subjective music-to-voice balance remain unverified by direct listening.

axes.name: VO–illustration sync & entertainment
axes.rationale: The final sheets place historical observations before learning, route feedback before changing the learned rule, reveal case-specific outcomes with their narration, and give both rules shared next-test goals. The apparatus makes the explanation concrete. Several beats still express meaning mainly through arriving plaques, especially management names and the last research-limit statement.

axes.name: Accuracy & sourcing
axes.rationale: Read verified findings, all17 claims, sources, post and VO against current plates. Constant and stock-linked results stay separate and each says versus its comparison; no synthetic numerical chart is presented as data. Public code is availability rather than reproduced proof; management advantage remains unproven. Central result claims rely on the paper rather than independent replication, and the supplied validator notes a publisher-access caveat.

axes.name: Alaska authenticity & cultural respect
axes.rationale: Eastern Bering Sea pollock, AFSC affiliations and NOAA/Council roles are specific and carefully scoped. The film neither invents stakeholder endorsement nor claims bycatch or livelihood improvements. Harbor geometry is generic and does not add much locally distinctive visual detail, but there is no cultural misstep visible.

axes.name: Writing & post quality
axes.rationale: VO and post explain recruitment and breeding biomass in plain terms, preserve the honest turn and finish with a real question about catches and breeding fish. The post makes its comparison logic clear. Repeated qualifications around comparison and simulations slow the prose somewhat but protect the claim scope.

limitations: No direct human listening or continuous real-time playback; sound taste uses current measured reports and event evidence.
Motion inspected from eight actual consecutive-frame strips and narrative sequence from all six final sheets; not every video frame inspected.
Source accuracy checked against the supplied current primary-source verification packet; no independent numerical reproduction of the research.
Square crop was not a second aesthetic subject; this score grades only current 9:16 master.
scoring_protocol: First fresh full-panel card; scores formed from current evidence and historical calibration images before any repair briefing or changelog.
